requiredBehaviors.behavior: mark the De Novo strategy blocked or require alternative pathway review when the risk-control story is insufficient
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Strategy states include blocked-by-risk-controls and alternative-pathway-review-required, and the skill forbids forcing De Novo when controls cannot support reasonable assurance.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve the unresolved control and evidence gaps rather than weakening them to maintain a De Novo narrative
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Control/evidence gaps are explicit outputs with impact, stop conditions and re-evaluation triggers.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: force a class II De Novo strategy despite an inadequate control story
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The Pathway-not-forced principle requires alternative-pathway review when the risk-control story is inadequate.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: hide high-impact residual uncertainty behind a generic proposed special control
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Proposed controls require risk links, verification/evidence needs and residual uncertainty.
